abstract: Codebase DNA Guardian extracts a project's unwritten conventions — naming patterns, architectural rules, error handling strategies, import styles, dependency choices — and enforces them whenever an AI agent writes new code. It produces a machine-readable DNA profile (.claude/dna.md) from a surgical 15–20 file sample and acts as a passive guardian: HARD rules stop generation, SOFT rules add a footnote, PREF rules apply silently. Supports monorepos with per-service DNA overrides, pre-merge gates, onboarding briefs, convention drift detection, and an interactive React health dashboard.
